name: Synchronicity Earth partner funding
summary: Multi-year funding for overlooked and underfunded conservation work on forests, freshwater and oceans. Synchronicity Earth finds its partners through its own networks rather than open calls.

geography.label: sub-Saharan Africa, Southeast Asia, Latin America and Melanesia

applicant_types.quote: We support a diverse range of partners, from small, locally led organisations acting with and for the communities they are part of, Indigenous Peoples and Indigenous-led funds, to larger national and international NGOs working on policy and advocacy.

geography.quote: Since our founding in 2009, we have distributed over £27M in grant funding to more than 180 organisations protecting forest, freshwater, and ocean biodiversity in sub-Saharan Africa, Southeast Asia, Latin America and Melanesia.

access.quote: Instead we actively seek out partners through our networks, and we only ask for a written overview of the work planned once we have money committed and available.
